children: MIAMI, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Starwood Property Trust, Inc. (

) ("the Company") today announced that the Company's Board of Directors has declared a dividend of $0.48 per share of common stock for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The dividend is payable on October 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026.

), an affiliate of global private investment firm Starwood Capital Group, is a leading diversified finance company with a core focus on the real estate and infrastructure sectors. As of June 30, 2026, the Company has successfully deployed $120 billion of capital since inception and manages a portfolio of $32 billion across debt and equity investments. Starwood Property Trust's investment objective is to generate attractive and stable returns for shareholders, primarily through dividends, by leveraging a premiere global organization to identify and execute on the best risk adjusted returning investments across its target assets.
